selection: first three lexicographic allowlisted 8D datasets, frozen by prior read-only audit, no loss filter
prediction: For each fixed function, centering to 0 should favor Adam; centering to either -3 or +3 should favor SGD. This is an extrapolation of the absolute-mean stump, nine fresh intervention signs; original means are reference checks, not new predictions.
competitors: Mean-mediated offset fitting: changing only label offset changes paired optimizer gap; centering reduces SGD relative benefit.
Shape-specific mechanism: centered functions retain distinct winner directions despite identical train mean.
Initial residual mismatch: optimizer effects depend on target mean relative to initial output and sign, rather than absolute target mean alone.
unit: function x transformation, ten paired training seeds 0-9; seeds do not count as ten independent target predictions
threshold_note: research keeps all finite endpoints; 1e12 finite process-only guard, not benchmark performance scoring. Report benchmark MSE cutoff exceedances separately.
holdout_policy: training lab datasets only; dataset test.pt is within-instance held-out measurement, not final KB benchmark test; no final test question reading or solve rerun.
